title: Johann Koerbecke - Wikipedia
content: He is believed to have worked with the Master of the Schöppingen Altarpiece and the Master of 1473") [fr]. He was the first painter from Westphalia who can be named. His presence is attested to for the first time in 1443, when he and his wife, Elsa, took possession of his father's house in Münster. It is likely that he studied with his father, Heinrich, and another local artist, in the 1430s. Nothing is known of Heinrich's work, although his acquisition of the house and workshop is attested to in 1435. Johann is mentioned several times, between 1453 and 1484, in documents from Münster, including invoices for altarpieces and as a witness to marriages and other legal contracts.
